mapper.sql: task_id, parent_task_id, project_id, milestone_id, task_type_id, task_status_id, title, content, assignee_user_id, priority_code, progress_rate, start_date, due_date, estimated_hours, actual_hours, is_deleted, created_by, created_at, updated_at, est_start_date, est_end_date, attachment_group_id, editor_user_id
mapper.select: SELECT t.task_id, t.parent_task_id, t.milestone_id, t.task_type_id, t.task_status_id, t.title, t.content, t.assignee_user_id, u.user_name, t.priority_code, c.code_name, t.progress_rate, t.start_date, t.due_date, p.project_name, t2.type_name, t3.status_name FROM tasks t JOIN projects p ON t.project_id = p.project_id JOIN task_types t2 ON t.task_type_id = t2.task_type_id JOIN task_statuses t3 ON t.task_status_id = t3.task_status_id JOIN common_code c ON t.priority_code = c.code_value JOIN users u ON t.assignee_user_id = u.user_id WHERE t.project_id = #{id} OR p.parent_project_id = #{pid}
SELECT project_name, start_date, end_date FROM projects WHERE project_id = #{id}

SELECT t.task_id, t.title, t.content, t.assignee_user_id, u.user_name AS assignee_user_name, c.code_name AS priority_name, t.progress_rate, t.start_date, t.due_date, t.actual_hours, t.estimated_hours, t.est_start_date, t.est_end_date, t.created_at, p.project_name, p2.project_name AS parent_project_name, t2.type_name, t3.status_name FROM tasks t JOIN projects p ON t.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN projects p2 ON p.parent_project_id = p.project_id JOIN task_types t2 ON t.task_type_id = t2.task_type_id JOIN task_statuses t3 ON t.task_status_id = t3.task_status_id JOIN common_code c ON t.priority_code = c.code_value JOIN users u ON t.assignee_user_id = u.user_id WHERE t.task_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO time_entries( time_entry_id, task_id, user_id, work_date, hours, created_at, task_desc) VALUES (TIME_ENTRIES_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{taskId}, #{userId}, #{workDate}, #{hours}, SYSDATE, #{taskDesc})
mapper.select: SELECT t.work_date, t.hours, t.created_at, t.task_desc, u.user_name FROM time_entries t JOIN users u ON t.user_id = u.user_id WHERE t.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM (SELECT time_entry_id FROM time_entries ORDER BY created_at DESC) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_logs(activity_log_id, target_type, target_id, action_type, actor_user_id, before_value, after_value, created_at) VALUES (ACTIVITY_LOGS_SEQ.NEXTVAL, 'time_entries', #{targetId}, 'J1', #{actorUserId}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT ROWNUM AS idx ,A.* FROM( SELECT t.created_at, a.before_value, a.after_value, a.action_type, u.user_name, a.target_type, t.task_desc FROM activity_logs a JOIN time_entries t ON a.target_id = t.time_entry_id JOIN users u ON a.actor_user_id = u.user_id WHERE target_type = 'time_entries' AND t.task_id = #{id} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC) A
